name: BLUE_DB
tagline: A local-level election database for 31 European countries (2001–2025).
description_short: BLUE_DB is a Europe-wide database of municipality-level results of national parliamentary and European Parliament elections.
citation: Hublet, F., & Chiecchio, N. (2026). BLUE_DB — Basic Local Units Election Database. Paris: Groupe d'études géopolitiques. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21434112

code.applies_to: The BLUE_DB code, the blue_maps library and this viewer.

data.name: MIT License
data.applies_to: The election results, party and geographic typology tables assembled by BLUE_DB, as published on Zenodo.

third_party.name: Party crosswalk — Party Facts
